item.title: Spartans have strong showing at Bear River Classic

item.title: 18th annual Christmas Market comes to town
item.description: CARBON COUNTY — The largest ever Christmas Treasures Market opened shop for the day on Saturday, Dec. 6 at the Carbon County Event Center. With over 80 vendors, shoppers could find hundreds of gifts and services to purchase. Almost all the stands were local companies, offering jewelry, trinkets, décor, snacks, blankets, candles and more.
